input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in p0030 runs to Licensee alone. Affiliates (a defined term at 1.1) and contractors are not merely unnamed but affirmatively excluded: p0045 bars use or access by "any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee", p0042 limits training to employees, and p0041/p0085 permit third-party access only with Licensor's prior written consent granted at its discretion. There is therefore no notice-based path to add affiliates, so the clause fails the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice) on a material term. Successor transfer is partially addressed elsewhere — p0149 read with the Change of Control provisions (p0134) requires Licensor consent that "will not unreasonably withhold", which is close to the fallback on M&A continuity, so we have not redlined that point. The revocability concern (immediate termination on any breach without cure under Article IV) is a termination-rights issue handled under that rule. Minimal redline extends the grant and conforms the access restriction to cover Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf.

proposal.summary: Extend licence grant to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and conformed the access restriction accordingly, since our playbook requires operational use by affiliates and contractors rather than employees only. If preferred, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to Licensor.

ops.oldText: grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use
ops.newText: grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use

ops.oldText: by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee for use in the Field of Use.
ops.newText: by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf, in each case for use in the Field of Use.
